definitions.U: Exact compute overlap / (32 * common window duration), including idle time in denominator.
definitions.class_U: Class compute overlap / class admitted-active overlap; includes first-layer waiting.
definitions.nominal: Current admitted request actual per-disk per-layer V/C on every positive event interval; next-request L0 is not added again. This is reference demand, not measured physical I/O.
definitions.nominal_layer_layout: Requires constant per-request per-disk layer volumes; rejects varying layer layouts instead of averaging them.
definitions.physical: Exact SSD-service and NPU-link interval integrals from retained 2-second bins; available only for windows whose boundaries are retained bin edges.
definitions.internal_release_cohort: Next-layer prefetch release occurs within half-open window; retain full C+stall and completion beyond the window; include every zero stall.
definitions.complete_internal_cycles: Only same-request cycles entirely inside the window; layer-average utilization is distinct from class active-time U.
definitions.internal_C_over_D: C / (C + exposed next-layer stall); this uses completion logs, without physical trace it is not an independent bandwidth measurement.
definitions.slo: Admission cohort, followed to final prefill completion; thresholds 1.5 or 2 times own pure compute. Proxy for TTFT, not a first-token event or arrival-to-first-token measurement.
definitions.role_selection: Roles come from each request load.role. Explicit short_roles wins; otherwise use metadata.short_roles or canonical S/S1/S2 names only. Never infer A/B short roles.
definitions.mixed_card_count: Count of cards with positive compute from every distinct role; retains the stronger all-role-coverage definition.
definitions.long_short_mixed: Positive compute from any specified short role and any remaining long role on the same card. For L/S1/S2, requires L and at least one short subtype, not both. Pass means all 32 cards meet this mixture condition; active-whole-window is reported separately.
